intro.title: Great food in Costa Rica, without lifting a finger.
intro.lead: We are a Costa Rica catering company offering full service catering, private chefs and cooking classes.

party.title: Host the party, enjoy the party
party.text: From an intimate dinner for two to a wedding for one hundred, we plan, shop and cook so you can spend the day with your guests.

dinner.title: Come home to dinner
dinner.text: Spend your vacation on the beach or in the jungle and return to a home cooked meal already in the making.

classes.title: Take the flavors home
classes.text: Our family-friendly, hands-on classes teach you local ingredients and recipes you can cook again long after the trip.

desiree.tagline: Meals that taste like where you are
desiree.text: American, French and Vietnamese, Desiree moved to Costa Rica 30 years ago and blends her background into an inventive fusion of cuisines. She knows where to find the best local seafood and produce, and she is just as happy making old-fashioned comfort favorites.

juan.tagline: Authentic Costa Rican hospitality, from the grill to the glass
juan.text: A retired high school horticulture teacher, Juan now spends his time as a chef and bartender. He is a master of the grill and of mixology, so expect a whole fish wrapped in banana leaves or a made-from-scratch Margarita.

cta.title: Ready when you are
cta.text: Tell us the occasion, the date and how many people, and we will take it from there.
